en.headline: Belt and Road Summit opens Wednesday with new Go Global chapter
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the two-day Wan Chai gathering will add a session to help mainland firms expand overseas, as Hong Kong hosts the 11th edition of the event.
body: The 11th Belt and Road Summit will be held on Wednesday and Thursday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, co-organised by the Hong Kong government and the Trade Development Council.

Writing in his weekly blog on Sunday, Financial Secretary Paul Chan said this year’s programme, themed “Advancing high-quality development, embarking on a new journey”, would for the first time include a dedicated Go Global chapter to support mainland enterprises expanding overseas. He said the summit would also cover energy, artificial intelligence, the low-altitude economy and urban development, with site visits arranged for delegates.

Chan said the government’s GoGlobal Task Force had helped more than 300 mainland companies set up or expand in Hong Kong since it was established last year. He cited official figures that more than 100 Belt and Road enterprises are listed in the city, with a combined market value exceeding HK$340 billion.

The finance chief also pointed to trade with ASEAN, the Middle East and Central Asia, which he said now accounts for about 17 per cent of Hong Kong’s total trade after growing at nearly 10 per cent a year over five years. Chief Executive John Lee is scheduled to speak at the opening session.

zh.headline: 一帶一路高峰論壇周三開幕 首設「走出去」環節
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波周日在網誌表示，第十一屆一帶一路高峰論壇本周三至四在灣仔會展舉行，首次增設協助內地企業出海的專題環節。
body: 由特區政府與香港貿易發展局合辦的第十一屆一帶一路高峰論壇，將於周三及周四在灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行。
財政司司長陳茂波周日在每周網誌寫道，本屆論壇主題為「推進高質量發展　開啓新征程」，首次增設「走出去」專章，協助內地企業拓展海外業務。他指論壇亦會涵蓋能源、人工智能、低空經濟及城市發展等範疇，並安排實地考察促進交流。
陳茂波表示，政府「走出去」專責小組自去年成立以來，已協助逾300家內地企業在港開設或擴展業務。他引述數據指，現時有逾100家一帶一路相關企業在港上市，總市值超過3,400億港元。
他亦提到，東盟、中東及中亞市場佔香港貿易總額約17%，過去五年平均每年增長近一成。行政長官李家超將出席開幕環節。
